name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses jointly express the task. Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) plus hard Existence(has_door_key) captures 'move the ball before you take the key' and forces the blocker move; soft Absence(key_lost) matches the 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' preference (key_lost already encodes the closed-door condition, so Absence is right); soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever holding the key, have the door open at that moment or afterwards' with the preference cue; hard Existence(target_picked_up) is the final command.

texts: If the ball is moved away from the door, the key is picked up at some point after that.
Make sure the agent picks up the door key.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever the agent is holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards.
Pick up the target box in the other room.
